title: $D$-term and $F$-term potential of non-Abelian D7-branes in IIB Calabi-Yau orientifolds
summary: We derive the 4d $D$-term and $F$-term potential generated by a D7-brane stack in Calabi-Yau orientifold compactifications of type IIB string theory, taking into account the effect of worldvolume and ISD bulk fluxes and the non-Abelian nature of the brane fields. This potential is an important ingredient for moduli stabilization in IIB, e.g., in de Sitter scenarios using a T-brane uplift.
